name: KLIK Disposable | Orange Cream
description: Our Orange Cream delivers a smooth and creamy experience, combining the bright, citrusy flavor of fresh oranges with a rich, vanilla-like creaminess. This vape offers a nostalgic taste reminiscent of a classic orange creamsicle, creating a balanced and refreshing inhale. Ideal for those who enjoy a sweet and tangy flavor profile, the Orange Cream flavor enhances the THC experience with its comforting and indulgent taste, making it a delightful choice for a relaxing and flavorful session.
